summary: Iteration 133 - tested the 3 new features: (1) Batch Inbound Receiving with per-row job badges, (2) Playwright concurrency cap of 3 (queued/processing phases), (3) per-line Ship Status column in the Stock Transfer detail modal. Backend: 17 pytest tests passed / 2 skipped (no STO carries gi_line_status yet - every existing order predates the field), 0 failed. Frontend: bulk select/select-all/clear/count, non-blocking confirm dialog (closed in 1.1s), Queued->Processing->Done badge lifecycle, disabled checkbox+Receive for running rows, generic wording in badges/tooltips, and the new Ship Status column all verified live. Concurrency cap PROVEN live: batch of 4 real orders -> exactly 3 badges showed 'Processing' and the 4th stayed 'Queued' (confirmed in both UI and background_jobs docs: 3x phase='processing', 1x phase='queued'). One real end-to-end SAP Goods Receipt completed (STO-000068: job status=done, phase=done, progress 1/1, result.status='received', order removed from /pending, receipt_status='received' persisted).

minor.issue: Orphaned inbound_receipt jobs are correctly marked failed with a generic 'Interrupted by a backend restart/deploy - please retry' message, but the message is NOT persisted onto the STO doc's receipt_error (unlike the run() exception path in server.py:5524). After the user refreshes, those rows (STO-000065/66/67 right now) show plain 'Pending Receipt' with no hint that their batch was interrupted.

Headless Chromium child processes are NOT reaped when the app shuts down/reloads: after a hot-reload with 3 jobs in flight, 18 chrome processes stayed alive and had to be pkill-ed manually (memory leak risk in the 3-slot container).

progress_current is only incremented per delivery note, so a single-delivery order sits at 0/1 for the whole 40-90s run and the ETA text never counts down ('est. 2 min remaining' the entire time). Also 65s -> Math.ceil(65/60) renders as '2 min' which overstates a ~1 min job.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH VISUAL BUG: the 'Processing - est. 2 min remaining' badge has no whitespace-nowrap and the Status column has no min-width, so the text collapses to ~1 character per line and renders VERTICALLY, overflowing/overlapping several rows below it (clearly visible in the batch screenshot). 'Queued'/'Done' are short enough to render fine. Fix: add whitespace-nowrap to the badge div (InboundReceiptsPage.js:381) and/or a min-w on the Status TableCell.

With the new 9th column the items table is wider than the max-w-3xl modal; the last column ('Ship Status') is clipped at the right edge until the user horizontally scrolls the inner div. Consider widening the modal (max-w-5xl) or dropping/merging a low-value column.

integration_issues.issue: activeJobs is client-only state and is never rehydrated from the backend. After an F5 (or opening the page on another device/tab) while jobs are still running, the badges disappear entirely and the Receive button/checkbox become enabled again - the user has NO indication a job is ON, which is exactly the visibility the user asked for. (Duplicate posting is still safe: the POST correctly returns the existing running job_id - verified.) Fix: expose the active job (phase/progress/error) on GET /api/inbound-receipts/pending, or add a GET .../active-jobs the page seeds activeJobs from on mount.

integration_issues.flow: Backend restart while Playwright jobs run
integration_issues.issue: A hot-reload/restart while 3 receive jobs were in flight left uvicorn permanently hung (localhost:8001 and the public URL returned no response / 502 for ~10 min, whole app blank) until a manual 'supervisorctl restart backend'. Root cause: in-flight asyncio Playwright tasks + threads blocked on the threading.Semaphore prevent the graceful shutdown from completing, and the orphaned Chromium processes survive. Recommend timeout_graceful_shutdown, cancelling/awaiting the job tasks in a shutdown handler, and killing spawned browsers there.

issues: Page copy still says 'closes every SAP delivery line', 'SAP #', 'SAP Delivery Notif', dialog 'closed in SAP' and toast 'received in full - closed in SAP' (76 'SAP' occurrences). These are pre-existing business-level SAP references, NOT automation leakage - the new badges/tooltips/progress panel are fully generic ('Queued', 'Waiting for an available processing slot', 'Processing - est. Xs remaining'). Flagging only so the user can confirm the business-level 'SAP' wording is intentional.

action_items: Add whitespace-nowrap / column min-width to the inbound receipt job badge so 'Processing - est. X remaining' stops rendering vertically over other rows (HIGH)
Rehydrate activeJobs from the backend on page mount (expose active job phase/progress on /api/inbound-receipts/pending) so badges survive a refresh
Persist the orphan-recovery message onto the STO doc's receipt_error in job_store.recover_orphaned_jobs so interrupted rows explain themselves after a refresh
Kill/await spawned Chromium browsers on app shutdown and add timeout_graceful_shutdown so a restart during a receive doesn't hang the backend and leak chrome processes
Widen the Stock Transfer detail modal (max-w-5xl) so the new Ship Status column isn't clipped
Increment progress_current per SAP step (not only per delivery) so the ETA actually counts down on single-delivery orders
critical_code_review_comments: playwright_concurrency: queued jobs block a default-executor thread via `await asyncio.to_thread(semaphore.acquire)`. The default loop executor has only ~20 threads (16 CPUs) while the UI happily lets a user 'Select all' 34 pending STOs - 30+ jobs parked in acquire() would exhaust the executor and stall every other asyncio.to_thread DB/SAP call app-wide. Recommend a dedicated small ThreadPoolExecutor for the semaphore wait, or an app-level asyncio queue of pending jobs instead of parking threads.

StockTransferPage lineShipStatus() matches gi_line_status by product_id only, ignoring line_no. An STO with the same product on two lines will show line 1's status on both rows, and both rows get the SAME data-testid (stock-transfer-detail-ship-status-<product_id>). Match on line_no first, fall back to product_id.

server.py:5523 - the failure path sets status='failed' but never sets phase, leaving phase='processing' on a failed job doc (UI happens to check status first, so cosmetic only, but the doc is inconsistent).
InboundReceiptsPage.js is 544 lines with the poller, badge helpers and 2 dialogs inline; consider extracting the job poller into a hook (useReceiveJobs) before it grows further.

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all new batch/badge/ship-status mechanics work; badge text overflow + no badge rehydration after refresh are the two defects

Real SAP writes made: batch of 4 (STO-000068/67/66/65) started - only STO-000068 fully completed a real Goods Receipt (now receipt_status='received'); the other 3 were interrupted by a backend hot-reload and are back to 'Pending Receipt' with failed job docs. Their SAP-side state was NOT re-verified - the main agent/user should confirm STO-000065/66/67 in SAP before retrying them (a partially-posted receipt is possible).

rca_of_the_issue: Badge overflow: the badge container (InboundReceiptsPage.js:381) uses flex without whitespace-nowrap inside an auto-width table cell, so the long 'Processing - est. 2 min remaining' string wraps at ~1 char per line and paints over adjacent rows. Backend hang: uvicorn's file-watch reload fired while 3 asyncio Playwright tasks held browsers and a 4th thread was blocked in threading.Semaphore.acquire(); the old worker never finished shutting down, the new one never bound to 8001, so every request returned 502 for ~10 minutes and the 18 Chromium processes were left orphaned. Startup recovery (job_store.recover_orphaned_jobs) then correctly marked the 4 jobs failed with a user-safe message.
